title: DataHerb catalog entry
description: One file in catalog/. Points at a dataset's metadata (git repo, S3 prefix, URL, or local folder) or embeds it. Any dataset-metadata field set here overrides the remote value, so the catalog can add tags, owners or status jobs without touching the data.

store.description: Name of a store in dataherb.config.yml. Defaults to the store of type git when `repo` is given, else `local`.

ref.description: git: branch, tag or sha. Defaults to the store's default_ref.

url.description: http: base URL holding the dataset.

metadata_path.description: Metadata file relative to the dataset base. Defaults to trying dataherb.json, dataherb.yml, .dataherb/metadata.yml.

inline.description: Metadata is fully in this file; nothing is fetched.
